decisions.technical_reason: Accepted bundle graph-v2 was loaded directly and profiled, correcting the prior trace-only relation profile.
Runtime proof maps M24 concept set to accepted production graph and cites graph-expanded passage evidence disjoint from old 20 concepts.
Non-temporal precedes remains downweighted, structural-only relation metadata is emitted, and verifier blocks precedes-to-dependency upgrades.
Provider task carries required_facets; verifier enforces missing-facet failure code M26-PA7-ME-029 before answer acceptance.

decisions.finding: P0.5 section-level evidence over title leakage observability
decisions.technical_reason: Public evidence summaries include evidence_text_role and section_granularity, enabling title/root leakage audit.
Verifier rejects selected evidence with zero used claims; response telemetry reports selected_evidence_used_fraction and selected_gt_zero_used_zero_failure.
Existing Phase 1 relation/query relevance gate retained; no broad 2-hop without relevance threshold.

Runtime now emits rerank_score, hop, relation types, seed concepts, relevance scores, structural_relation_only; exhaustive dropped-candidate feature dump is deferred as non-blocking to avoid large payload exposure.

decisions.finding: Claim schema lacks semantic proposition/surface assertion
decisions.technical_reason: Provider contract v2 requests claim.surface_text; verifier checks semantic overlap, unsupported numbers, modality strengthening, graph relation responsiveness, and orphan anchors.

decisions.finding: Natural answer fallback silently masks writer failure
decisions.technical_reason: Invalid nonempty answer_text now raises verifier codes and enters repair/deterministic-verified path with answer_source telemetry instead of silent fallback.

decisions.finding: Runtime-owned final citations from model anchors
decisions.technical_reason: answer_text [[claim_id]] anchors are replaced by runtime-owned [claim_ref] citations only after support verification.

decisions.finding: Do not broad-fabricate deterministic relational synthesis
decisions.technical_reason: Deterministic repair is retained only as exact-span, same-verifier synthesis and is explicitly marked answer_source=deterministic_verified_evidence_synthesis with trigger codes; it remains visible for GPT-D audit.
Runner supports GPT-C case/annotation files and emits evaluator-compatible normalized rows; deterministic and real-provider normalized outputs pass evaluator.

decisions.finding: Minimum 24 real-provider rows with critical repeats
decisions.technical_reason: Real-provider run includes 18 full rows plus 6 critical repeat rows, unsupported claims 0.
Automated evidence-aware rubric scoring is included and labeled; final human-independent audit is left to GPT-D per instruction, without self-acceptance.
